title: On the Burning Game: Nordhaus-Gaddum Bounds and Graph Products
summary: We continue research on the burning game on graphs. Given a graph $G$, two players, Burner and Staller, take turns in selecting vertices of $G$ to burn. All burned vertices spread fire to unburned neighboring vertices, as in the burning process. The goal of Burner is to burn the graph as quickly as possible, while Staller wants the process to last as long as possible.
